h1: Smartwatch 9th Generation 2.09 inch LCD TFT with Bluetooth Calling BP Monitor and Multi Sports Modes (Black 45mm)

description:
Overview: Smartwatch 9th Generation is an entry-level smartwatch with a 2.09 inch LCD TFT display designed for everyday connectivity and basic health tracking. It pairs with compatible Android and iOS phones to mirror notifications and support Bluetooth calling for quick conversations from the wrist.

Display & Design: The 2.09 inch LCD TFT screen offers a large viewing area for watch faces, call screens and notifications. The 45 mm black case has a familiar rectangular design aimed at users who prefer a bold, easy-to-read display.

Health & Fitness: The watch includes basic health features such as heart rate and blood pressure tracking, along with sleep monitoring and multiple sports modes to log everyday activities. Readings from such watches are typically for general wellness awareness and are not a substitute for medical devices.

Connectivity & Battery: With Bluetooth connectivity and a rated range of up to around 10 meters in typical conditions, the watch can handle calls, alerts and app notifications when your phone is nearby. Battery life is rated for around 3–5 days depending on watch face choice, brightness, notifications and calling usage.

Convenience & Protection: Wireless charging support and a splash-resistant design help fit the watch into daily routines such as office, commuting and light workouts. It is suitable for casual exposure to sweat and splashes but is not intended for swimming or high-pressure water activities.
